ICS: Ask-Respond-Tell (ART) in ARTS: Did the student initiate the patient education conversation by asking an open-ended question regarding tests, treatments, or lifestyle?
MI: Did the student elicit your comfort and preparedness to receive information regarding vaccination?
Seeking Solutions (S) in ARTS: Did the student outline a plan based on your conversation?
Ask-Respond-Tell (ART) in ARTS: Was the discussion about the plan a dialogue between the doctor and patient as opposed to a lecture?
MI and Seeking Solutions (S) in ARTS : Did the student elicit your comfort and preparedness to take part in the recommended plan?
Ask-Respond-Tell (ART) in ARTS: Did the student use the skills of empathy in relation to an expressed or potential feeling/emotion? (Reflection, legitimation, exploration)?
Did the student make you feel supported?
Seeking Solutions (S) in ARTS: Did the student end the encounter and clarify next steps?
Did the student communicate clearly? (volume, pacing, enunciation)
PROF: Did the student behave professionally by showing respect?
Did the student avoid verbal or nonverbal judgmental behaviors?
